outlooks.summary: CLUSTERS OF STRONG TO SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ARE POSSIBLE TODAY FROM WISCONSIN AND LOWER MICHIGAN SOUTHWARD ACROSS PARTS OF THE MID MISSISSIPPI VALLEY AND SOUTHERN PLAINS STATES.

sections.title: UPPER/MID MS VALLEY
sections.text: WATER VAPOR LOOPS SHOW A STRONG UPPER TROUGH MOVING ACROSS THE ROCKIES AND CENTRAL PLAINS. AN EMBEDDED SHORTWAVE TROUGH WILL ROTATE FROM KS INTO MN/WI DURING THE PERIOD...ENHANCING THE RISK OF SCATTERED SHOWERS AND THUNDERSTORMS ACROSS PARTS OF THE UPPER/MID MS VALLEY. SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS WILL LIKELY BE ONGOING AT 12/12Z ALONG/AHEAD OF THE SURFACE COLD FRONT FROM PARTS OF IA SOUTHWARD INTO EASTERN KS AND CENTRAL OK. THE EXTENT OF DESTABILIZATION AHEAD OF THE FRONT IS UNCERTAIN DUE TO CLOUD DEBRIS. HOWEVER...MOST 00Z MODEL SOLUTIONS SUGGEST MODERATE INSTABILITY REDEVELOPS THIS AFTERNOON FROM EASTERN IA INTO WESTERN MO. FORECAST SOUNDINGS IN THIS CORRIDOR INDICATE MLCAPE VALUES OF 1500-2000 J/KG ALONG WITH 30-40 KNOTS OF EFFECTIVE SHEAR. THUNDERSTORMS WILL LIKELY REDEVELOP ALONG THE FRONT IN THIS AREA...WITH SUPERCELL STRUCTURES EXPECTED. THE STRONGER STORMS WILL BE CAPABLE OF LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS. LOW LEVEL VERTICAL SHEAR MAY ALSO BE SUFFICIENT FOR A TORNADO OR TWO IN THIS REGION.

sections.title: OK/AR/TX
sections.text: MODEL GUIDANCE IS RELATIVELY CONSISTENT IN DEVELOPING SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS ALONG THE FRONT FROM EASTERN OK/WESTERN AR SOUTHWARD INTO CENTRAL TX. MLCAPE VALUES WILL BE HIGHER IN THIS REGION COMPARED TO FARTHER NORTH /2000-2500 J/KG/...BUT EFFECTIVE SHEAR VALUES WILL BE RATHER WEAK. MULTICELL STORM STRUCTURES SHOULD BE DOMINANT IN THIS ZONE WITH HAIL AND GUSTY WINDS POSSIBLE. ISOLATE STRONG/SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS MAY DEVELOP SOUTHWARD ALONG THE DRYLINE ALL THE WAY TO THE RIO GRANDE DURING THE EVENING.

sections.title: LOWER MI
sections.text: CURRENT SURFACE ANALYSIS SHOWS A WEAK WARM FRONT EXTENDING ACROSS CENTRAL LOWER MI. THIS BOUNDARY WILL LIFT SLOWLY NORTHWARD AND EXTEND ACROSS NORTHERN LAKE MI INTO THE THUMB OF LOWER MI BY AFTERNOON. SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS WILL LIKELY DEVELOP ALONG THE WARM FRONT DURING THE AFTERNOON...WITH ISOLATED SEVERE STORMS CAPABLE OF HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS POSSIBLE. ..HART/DEAN.. 05/12/2014

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A WIND DAMAGE THREAT IS EXPECTED TO DEVELOP LATE THIS MORNING ACROSS SERN WI AND NRN IL. THE THREAT SHOULD AFFECT THE MILWAUKEE AND CHICAGO AREAS IN A FEW HOURS. WW ISSUANCE MAY BE NEEDED ACROSS THE REGION OVER THE NEXT HALF HOUR.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE LATEST WSR-88D RADAR DATA SHOWS A SHORT LINE SEGMENT IN SWRN WI. A CORRIDOR OF MOISTURE IS LOCATED JUST AHEAD OF THE LINE EXTENDING NWD INTO SCNTRL WI WHERE SFC DEWPOINTS ARE IN THE MID 60S F AND MLCAPE IS ESTIMATED IN THE 100O TO 1500 J/KG RANGE. THE WSR-88D VWP AT MILWAUKEE SHOWS 45 KT OF 0-6 KM SHEAR WITH 30-40 KT OF FLOW JUST ABOVE THE SFC. THIS SHOULD BE FAVORABLE FOR A SEVERE THREAT AS THE LINE MOVES ACROSS SRN WI AND FAR NRN IL LATE THIS MORNING. WIND DAMAGE AND HAIL WILL BE THE PRIMARY THREATS WITH THE ACTIVITY.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLATED SEVERE THREAT IS EXPECTED TO DEVELOP EARLY THIS AFTERNOON. HAIL AND ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND GUSTS WILL BE POSSIBLE AS CELLS INTENSIFY. CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED FOR COLD POOL ORGANIZATION WITH THE POSSIBILITY OF WW ISSUANCE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE LATEST SFC ANALYSIS SHOWS A COLD FRONT EXTENDING SWD FROM ERN KS ACROSS ECNTRL OK INTO NCNTRL TX. SFC DEWPOINTS SOUTHEAST OF THE BOUNDARY ARE IN THE UPPER 60S AND LOWER 70S F WITH MLCAPE ESTIMATED IN THE 1500 TO 2500 J/KG RANGE. AS SFC HEATING CONTINUES AND LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE INCREASES ALONG THE BOUNDARY...STORMS SHOULD INCREASE IN COVERAGE AND GRADUALLY INTENSIFY. REGIONAL WSR-88D VWPS SHOWED 25 TO 35 KT OF 0-6 KM SHEAR WHICH SHOULD BE ENOUGH FOR AN ISOLATED SEVERE THREAT. AS LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES STEEPEN OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS...A WIND DAMAGE THREAT MAY DEVELOP WITH LINE SEGMENTS CAN ORGANIZE A COLD POOL. HAIL WILL ALSO BE POSSIBLE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TSTMS ACTIVITY IS EXPECTED TO INCREASE ALONG AND AHEAD OF A COLD FRONT MOVING INTO THE UPPER MIDWEST. A MOIST AND UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT OVER THE REGION IS EXPECTED TO SUPPORT STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS WITH LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS AS THE MAIN THREATS. A TORNADO OR TWO IS ALSO POSSIBLE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: 12Z DVN AND ILX SOUNDINGS SAMPLED A MOIST ENVIRONMENT CHARACTERIZED BY MEAN MIXING RATIOS GREATER THAN 13.5 G/KG. DEWPOINTS ACROSS THE REGION ARE IN THE MID TO UPPER 60S. CINH INHIBITION WILL QUICKLY ERODE WITH MODEST HEATING AND TSTM ACTIVITY IS EXPECTED TO INCREASE DURING THE NEXT HOUR. SURFACE ANALYSIS PLACES NUMEROUS BOUNDARIES OVER AREA. PRIMARY COLD FRONT EXTENDS SWD THROUGH W-CNTRL IA AND INTO FAR NW MO. MESO-LOW AHEAD OF THE FRONT...LIKELY RESULTANT FROM OVERNIGHT CONVECTION IS ANALYZED OVER DSM WITH AN OUTFLOW BOUNDARY EXTENDING EWD INTO FAR NW IL AND CONNECTING TO ONGOING CONVECTION ACROSS SRN WI. ANOTHER OUTFLOW APPEARS TO EXTEND FROM N-CNTRL MO /JUST N OF CDJ/ NEWD TOWARDS MLI IN FAR NWRN IL. THESE BOUNDARIES ARE EXPECTED TO PROVIDE IMPETUS FOR CONVECTIVE INITIATION AS WELL AS AREAS FOR UPDRAFT ENHANCEMENT DURING INTERACTION WITH ONGOING STORMS. THE AREA IS ON THE ERN EDGE OF THE BETTER SHEAR BUT AT LEAST MODERATE INSTABILITY AS WELL AS INTERACTIONS WITH SURFACE BOUNDARIES SHOULD RESULT IN SOME STRONG UPDRAFTS CAPABLE OF SVR HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS. UNCERTAINTY REGARDING TORNADO DEVELOPMENT IS HIGH BUT COMBINATION OF ABUNDANT LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE...NUMEROUS SURFACE BOUNDARIES...AND DECENT MID-LEVEL FLOW COULD SUPPORT A TORNADO OR TWO.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: DAMAGING WIND THREAT WITH A SECONDARY THREAT OF HAIL WILL PERSIST ACROSS MAINLY THE SERN PORTIONS OF WW 149. SOME ADDITIONAL TSTM DEVELOPMENT IS POSSIBLE ACROSS THE SRN PORTION OF THE WATCH /NRN IL/ WITH A THREAT OF MARGINALLY SVR HAIL AND GUSTY WINDS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: TSTM ACTIVITY CONTINUES SEWD ACROSS FAR SE WI AND INTO LAKE MI. THIS GENERAL TREND IS EXPECTED TO PERSIST WITH A CONTINUED THREAT FOR DAMAGING WINDS AND SOME HAIL. AREA SOUTH OF THIS MAIN LINE /NRN IL/ CONTINUED TO WARM WITH TEMPERATURES NOW IN THE UPPER 70S TO LOW 80S AMIDST DEWPOINTS IN THE UPPER 60S. MESOANALYSIS ESTIMATES MLCAPE THROUGHOUT THIS AREA FROM 1500 TO 2000 J PER KG WITH NO CINH REMAINING. AS A RESULT...ADDITIONAL TSTM DEVELOPMENT IS POSSIBLE SW OF THE CURRENT ACTIVITY ALONG AN OUTFLOW BOUNDARY. THE ENVIRONMENT IS SUPPORTIVE OF STRONG TO SVR STORMS WITH PRIMARY THREATS OF SVR HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS. ..MOSIER.. 05/12/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TSTMS OF LAKE MI ARE EXPECTED TO PERSIST WITH A RESULTANT THREAT OF DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL ACROSS SRN LWR MI. A WW IS LIKELY TO COVER THIS SVR THREAT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RECENT RADAR IMAGERY INDICATES TSTMS MOVING OVER LK MI HAVE TRANSITIONED FROM A MORE ELY STORM MOTION TO SELY AS THE AIRMASS SOUTH AND EAST HAS BECOME INCREASINGLY MORE UNSTABLE WHILE CINH REMAINS OVER THE AIRMASS N AND E. SURFACE ANALYSIS PLACES A WARM FRONT FROM JUST N OF MKG ESEWD TO JUST N OF DET. AIRMASS SOUTH OF THIS BOUNDARY IS CHARACTERIZED BY TEMPERATURES IN UPPER 70S TO MID 80S WITH DEWPOINTS GENERALLY IN THE MID 60S. MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES OVER THE AREA ARE NOT PARTICULARLY STEEP BUT THE DEGREE OF LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE IS STILL SUPPORTING MLCAPE AROUND 1000 J PER KG. GRR VAD WIND PROFILE REVEALS UNIDIRECTIONAL SHEAR WITH 0-6 KM BULK SHEAR OF 41 KT. AS SUCH...ONGOING TSTM ACTIVITY IS EXPECTED TO PERSIST WITH SOME INCREASED ORGANIZATION POSSIBLE. LINEAR MODE IS FAVORED WITH A PRIMARY THREAT OF DAMAGING WINDS AND A SECONDARY THREAT OF SVR HAIL. TORNADO THREAT IS LOW BUT BACKED WINDS ALONG AND JUST N OF THE WARM FRONT MAY ENHANCED LOW-LEVEL SHEAR ENOUGH FOR A TRANSIENT LOW-LEVEL CIRCULATION WITHIN THE CONVECTIVE LINE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TSTM ACTIVITY WILL GRADUALLY PUSH EWD WITH SOME THREAT FOR SMALL HAIL AND GUSTY WINDS. OVERALL SVR THREAT IS ANTICIPATED TO BE TOO LOW TO WARRANT A WW BUT TRENDS FOR INCREASED ORGANIZATION/UPSCALE GROWTH WILL BE MONITORED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RECENT 18Z SGF SOUNDING SAMPLED A MOIST AND MODERATELY UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT AHEAD OF A COLD FRONT SLOWLY PROGRESSING EWD. RELATIVELY WARM MID-LEVEL TEMPERATURES ASSOCIATED WITH A REMANENT EML AND PREVIOUS CONVECTION WILL LIMIT OVERALL INSTABILITY WITH MLCAPE ESTIMATED TO REMAIN BELOW 2000 J PER KG. THIS REGION IS ALSO ON THE SRN EDGE OF THE BETTER SHEAR...WHICH IS EXPECTED TO LIMIT OVERALL STORM ORGANIZATION. MOIST LOW-LEVEL ENVIRONMENT AND NELY ORIENTATION OF THE BULK SHEAR VECTOR IS EXPECTED TO RESULT IN PRIMARILY HEAVY RAIN WITH SOME SMALL HAIL AND GUSTY WINDS POSSIBLE. GREATEST SVR THREAT WILL RESULT FROM CELL MERGERS WHEN THE MAIN CONVECTIVE LINE INTERSECTS ANY ACTIVITY AHEAD OF IT. GIVEN THE ANTICIPATED LOW SVR THREAT A WW IS NOT CURRENTLY ANTICIPATED BUT TRENDS ACROSS THE AREA WILL BE MONITORED FOR INCREASED ORGANIZATION.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLATED SEVERE THREAT IS EXPECTED TO DEVELOP ACROSS PARTS OF SCNTRL AND SW TX OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. ISOLATED LARGE HAIL AND WIND DAMAGE WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH THE MORE INTENSE CELLS. WW ISSUANCE MAY BE NEEDED ACROSS THE MCD AREA LATER THIS AFTERNOON.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE LATEST SFC ANALYSIS SHOWS A COLD FRONT FROM NEAR BRADY TX EXTENDING SWWD TO NEAR DEL RIO TX. SOUTHEAST OF THE BOUNDARY...SFC DEWPOINTS ARE IN THE LOWER 70S F AND MLCAPE VALUES ARE ESTIMATED IN THE 2500 TO 3500 J/KG RANGE. IN ADDITION...SFC WINDS ARE BACKED TO THE EAST SOUTHEAST AT SAN ANTONIO WITH SOME DIRECTIONAL SHEAR EVIDENT ON REGIONAL WSR-88D VWPS. THE STRONG INSTABILITY COMBINED WITH INCREASING DEEP LAYER SHEAR LATE THIS AFTERNOON SHOULD BE ENOUGH FOR AN ISOLATED SEVERE THREAT. CELLS THAT INITIATE ALONG AND AHEAD OF THE COLD FRONT MAY BE ACCOMPANIED BY HAIL AND A FEW DAMAGING WIND GUSTS. IF THE STORMS CAN DEVELOP A COLD POOL...THEN A WEATHER WATCH MAY BE NEEDED LATE THIS AFTERNOON.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SVR THREAT IS EXPECTED TO PERSIST ACROSS WW 150 AS TSTMS TRACK EWD INTO A MORE UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT. UPSCALE GROWTH MAY RESULT IN AN INCREASE IN DAMAGING WINDS. SVR HAIL ALSO REMAINS POSSIBLE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: CLUSTER OF TSTMS ACROSS S-CNTRL IA/N-CNTRL MO IS EXPECTED TO CONTINUE NEWD WITH A CONTINUED THREAT OF SVR HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS. MESOANALYSIS ESTIMATES THE ENVIRONMENT IS CHARACTERIZED BY MLCAPE FROM 1500-2000 J PER KG AND EFFECTIVE SHEAR OF 35-45 KT...WHICH IS SUFFICIENT FOR UPDRAFT ORGANIZATION. RECENT RADAR IMAGERY SHOWS THE CELL MOVING THROUGH MARION AND MONROE COUNTIES HAS EXHIBITED DEVIANT RIGHT MOTION WITH NUMEROUS LOOSELY ORGANIZED CELL AHEAD OF IT. THESE TRENDS SUGGEST UPSCALE GROWTH MAY BE UNDERWAY WITH THE MOST FAVORABLE CORRIDOR FOR DAMAGING WINDS FROM JUST W OF OTM /S-CNTRL IA/ TO MLI /CNTRL IA-IL BORDER/. SOME SVR HAIL IS ALSO POSSIBLE AS STORM ORGANIZATION AND INSTABILITY BOTH INCREASE. ..MOSIER.. 05/12/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STRONG TSTMS ARE EXPECTED TO PERSIST ACROSS SRN LWR MI. MAIN THREATS WILL BE SVR HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS. HOWEVER...A NON-ZERO TORNADO THREAT EXISTS NEAR THE WARM FRONT WHERE LOW-LEVEL SHEAR AND VORTICITY ARE ENHANCED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RECENT SURFACE ANALYSIS PLACES A WARM FROM MKG SEWD TO JUST N OF TTF. TSTM ACTIVITY ALONG THIS BOUNDARY IN LIVINGSTON AND WASHTENAW COUNTIES HAS SHOWN TRANSIENT LOW-LEVEL ROTATION AS ENHANCED LOW-LEVEL SHEAR AND VORTICITY ALONG IT CONTRIBUTE TO A LOCALIZED TORNADO THREAT. THIS LOCALIZED THREAT ALONG THE BOUNDARY WILL PERSIST AS STORMS CONTINUE TO DEVELOP IN THE WARM SECTOR AND MOVE NEWD TOWARDS THE BOUNDARY. UNCERTAINTY IS HIGH BUT THERE IS AT LEAST SOME POTENTIAL FOR AN INCREASE IN DAMAGING WINDS WITH THE CONVECTION ACROSS S-CNTRL LWR MI AS FORWARD-PROPAGATION INCREASES AS A RESULT OF CELL INTERACTIONS. ..MOSIER.. 05/12/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: GREATEST RISK OF STRONG STORMS WITH HAIL HAS SHIFTED INTO SERN LOWER MI.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LONGER-LIVED WEAK MCV HAS TRANSLATED ACROSS LOWER MI AND CURRENTLY RESIDES NEAR OSC. STRONGEST ACTIVITY...LOOSELY AFFILIATED WITH THIS FEATURE...EXTENDS ACROSS SERN LOWER MI...EWD OVER WRN PARTS OF LAKE ERIE. THIS IS CORRELATED WELL WITH STRONGEST BOUNDARY LAYER HEATING WITHIN INFLOW REGION. WHILE NEW CONVECTION MAY CONTINUE TO EVOLVE ACROSS SERN LOWER MI...IT APPEARS THE GREATEST RISK MAY SHIFT OVER WRN LAKE ERIE THE NEXT FEW HOURS. AT THIS TIME A NEW WATCH IS NOT ANTICIPATED FOR NRN OH. UPSTREAM...MULTIPLE THUNDERSTORM CLUSTERS OVER WI SHOULD PROGRESS ACROSS SRN LAKE MI OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. IT REMAINS TO BE SEEN HOW THESE STORMS WILL REACT TO COLD LAKE WATER AND WHETHER THEY WILL MAINTAIN THEIR INTENSITY AS THEY APPROACH WRN PARTS OF WW151. LARGE HAIL IS THE GREATEST RISK WITH STORMS OVER LOWER MI. ..DARROW.. 05/12/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STRONG TO LOCALLY SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS WILL LIKELY PERSIST INTO THE EVENING ACROSS THE TX HILL COUNTRY. WHILE THIS ACTIVITY WILL NOT BE PARTICULARLY WELL-ORGANIZED...THE SEVERE THREAT IS HIGH ENOUGH MAKE WW ISSUANCE POSSIBLE BY 00Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A BAND OF INTENSE CONVECTION CONTINUES ALONG THE COLD FRONT IN TEXAS...WITH THE STRONGEST ACTIVITY OVER THE TX HILL COUNTRY WHERE THE ATMOSPHERE HAS BECOME STRONGLY UNSTABLE WITH MLCAPE IN THE 2500-3500 J/KG RANGE PER RECENT MESOANALYSIS. MARGINAL DEEP-LAYER SHEAR IS ONLY SUPPORTING ORGANIZED MULTI-CELL STORMS WITH TRANSIENT SUPERCELL STRUCTURES OCCASIONALLY NOTED. NEVERTHELESS...INSTABILITY IS SUFFICIENT TO SUPPORT ISOLATED LARGE HAIL AND POTENTIALLY DAMAGING WET MICROBURSTS. THIS ACTIVITY WILL CONTINUE TO BE FED BY MOIST LOW-LEVEL INFLOW THIS EVENING...WITH THE LINE POSSIBLY BECOMING ORIENTED MORE E-W LATER THIS EVENING. IT NOT CLEAR THAT THE SEVERE THREAT WILL BE OF A SUFFICIENT MAGNITUDE/DURATION TO REQUIRE WATCH ISSUANCE...BUT THE AREA WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED. HEAVY RAIN WILL ALSO BE A SIGNIFICANT THREAT WITH THESE SLOW-MOVING STORMS...REFER TO MPD 48 FROM WPC FOR MORE INFORMATION.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS WILL CONTINUE ACROSS WW152 FOR SEVERAL HOURS. FRONTAL SQUALL LINE SHOULD ADVANCE SLOWLY ACROSS IL AT ROUGHLY 15-20KT. WW WILL BE LOCALLY EXTENDED TO INCLUDE CHICAGO METRO.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: PRE-FRONTAL WARM ADVECTION CONTINUES TO AID DISCRETE THUNDERSTORM ACTIVITY ACROSS SRN WI AND NRN IL. STEEP LAPSE RATES IN THE LOWEST 3KM EXTEND ACROSS IL TO NEAR THE WI BORDER AND NEW TSTMS ARE DEVELOPING WITHIN THIS BUOYANT AIRMASS ALONG SRN FRINGE OF WW. LARGE HAIL REMAINS THE MOST LIKELY SEVERE THREAT WITH THIS PRE-FRONTAL CONVECTION AS IT SPREADS/DEVELOPS NEWD TOWARD SRN LAKE MI. WITH TIME...N-S FRONTAL SQUALL LINE WILL SPREAD SLOWLY ACROSS WRN IL INTO WW152 LATER THIS EVENING. ..DARROW.. 05/12/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE THREAT SHOULD END OVER ERN SECTIONS OF WW150 AFTER SQUALL LINE PASSAGE. LOCAL EXTENSION IN TIME MAY BE NEEDED FOR PUTNAM/BUREAU COUNTIES IN IL.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: WELL-DEFINED SQUALL LINE IS ADVANCING SLOWLY EWD AT ROUGHLY 15KT. THIS FRONTAL CONVECTION IS MOSTLY SUB-SEVERE BUT A FEW STRONGER STORMS WITH HAIL ARE EMBEDDED ALONG THE LINE...PARTICULARLY HANCOCK COUNTY IN WCNTRL IL. SEVERE THREAT SHOULD END QUICKLY WITH SQUALL LINE PASSAGE. ..DARROW.. 05/13/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A SUPERCELL THREAT WILL PERSIST FOR AT LEAST THE NEXT 1-2 HRS...WITH LARGE HAIL AND ISOLATED TORNADOES POSSIBLE. IT IS NOT CLEAR IF COVERAGE AND DURATION WILL WARRANT WATCH ISSUANCE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A COUPLE OF SUPERCELLS HAVE DEVELOPED OVER NERN OH AHEAD OF A CONVECTIVE CLUSTER MOVING SEWD OUT OF LOWER MICHIGAN. MODERATE INSTABILITY AND DEEP-LAYER SHEAR WILL CONTINUE TO SUPPORT ORGANIZED STORM STRUCTURES...THOUGH SOME DECREASE IS LIKELY LATER THIS EVENING AS THE BOUNDARY LAYER COOLS. ENLARGED LOW-LEVEL HODOGRAPHS NORTH OF A WARM FRONT DRAPED NORTHEAST OF A TOL-MFD-ZZV LINE WILL SUPPORT AN ISOLATED TORNADO THREAT AND POTENTIALLY SEVERE HAIL WITH ANY CELLS THAT CAN REMAIN DISCRETE. HOWEVER...STORM MODE MAY BECOME INCREASINGLY LINEAR AS CONVECTION REVELOPS OVER A LAKE-ENHANCED OUTFLOW BOUNDARY NOW PUSHING SOUTH OF CLEVELAND. IT IS NOT CLEAR IF THE DURATION OF THE THREAT WILL BE SUFFICIENT FOR WATCH ISSUANCE...THOUGH TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLATED SEVERE HAIL/WIND THREAT WILL EXIST TONIGHT WITH STORMS MOVING IN FROM THE NORTH AND WEST. AT THIS TIME...IT IS UNCERTAIN IF THE SEVERE THREAT IS SUFFICIENT FOR WW ISSUANCE...THOUGH TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE SWRN EDGE OF AN EXTENSIVE FRONTAL QLCS IS APPROACHING THE UVA/HDO AREAS AS OF 02Z...WHILE FURTHER SOUTH...OTHER STORMS ARE EMERGING SLOWLY NEWD OUT OF MEXICO NEAR LRD. A VERY WARM AND MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER IS CONTRIBUTING TO STRONG INSTABILITY...WITH MLCAPE AOA 3000 J/KG NOTED PER RECENT MESOANALYSIS. RELATIVELY WEAK MIDLEVEL FLOW IS RESULTING IN ONLY MODEST DEEP-LAYER SHEAR ACROSS THE REGION...WHICH SHOULD LIMIT THE SEVERE THREAT OVERALL. CONVECTION ALONG THE FRONT IS BEING UNDERCUT...THOUGH ISOLATED SEVERE HAIL/WIND IS POSSIBLE GIVEN THE STRONG INSTABILITY. FURTHER SOUTH NEAR LAREDO...CELL MERGERS HAVE RESULTED IN THE DEVELOPMENT OF A SMALL MCS. BACKED LOW-LEVEL FLOW IN THIS AREA IS RESULTING IN SLIGHTLY ENHANCED EFFECTIVE HELICITY OF 100-150 M2/S2...WHICH GIVEN THE STRONG INSTABILITY WILL SUPPORT SOMEWHAT MORE ORGANIZED STORM STRUCTURES WITH A CORRESPONDING THREAT OF HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND. AT THIS TIME...IT IS UNCERTAIN IF THE SEVERE THREAT WILL BE SUFFICIENT FOR A WATCH ISSUANCE...BUT CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED IN THIS AREA.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A LINE OF STORMS WITH STRONG WINDS CONTINUES TO SLOWLY DEVELOP EWD TOWARD THE MIDDLE TX COAST. STORMS MAY FILL IN ACROSS THE REMAINDER OF SRN TX THIS MORNING...WITH PERHAPS A THREAT OF ISOLATED SEVERE GUSTS OR MARGINAL HAIL.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A LINE OF STORMS CONTINUES TO PROPAGATE SLOWLY SEWD FROM THE MIDDLE TX COAST SWWD TO JUST W OF CRP FORMING ON THE OUTFLOW-REINFORCED FRONT. THESE STORMS HAVE SHOWN SIGNS OF STRONG WINDS AROUND 40-50 MPH WITH LITTLE OR NO HAIL. ALTHOUGH AMPLE MOISTURE AND INSTABILITY REMAIN ACROSS THE ENTIRE AREA...SHEAR PROFILES HAVE BEEN MARGINAL N OF CRP. HOWEVER...WINDS ALOFT DO INCREASE FARTHER S TOWARD THE RIO GRANDE...SUGGESTING A MORE FAVORABLE ENVIRONMENT FOR SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS. THE SWRN-MOST CELLS ALONG THE BOUNDARY...AND/OR JUST AHEAD OF IT...MAY HAVE A GREATER CHANCE AT BECOMING SEVERE DUE TO THE STRONGER SHEAR. THIS ALSO SUGGESTS MORE CELLULAR ACTIVITY...PERHAPS...WITH SOME HAIL THREAT AS WELL.
